pr_description.body:
## Why

GMI previously led with taxonomy and admission machinery, leaving readers to infer what a theme meant, what a company connection established, and which source date or lifecycle qualified the claim. This implements the Chairman's resumed product-and-code mandate in the existing frontend and consolidates Paper into one canonical product system.

## What changes

- Lead theme research with a plain-language topic explanation, dated company/product evidence, explicit limits and a concrete next action.
- Add the searchable company-evidence route. Preserve all 371 microthemes, parent paths, Core/Extended and evidence filters, the full index, taxonomy tree, value-chain lens and coverage arithmetic.
- Preserve URL/history restoration, responsive mobile browsing, related-topic navigation, keyboard/focus behavior, copy success/denial handling and server-rendered/no-JS/malformed-payload fallbacks.
- Reuse the existing theme, language, navigation and Brain owners. The original Brain root retains its palette, events and focus lifecycle; styling uses canonical tokens.
- Restrict public product rendering to the single separately cleared Micron observation, whose source was published on 26 February 2024, including its receipt, planned lifecycle, product/platform, source identity and visible EN/ZH attribution. ACCEPT/RATIFIED alone does not admit a new public fact.
- Exclude private graph/correction/raw-source context from Jinja, retire stale issuer output after withdrawal and refuse nonregular/symlink issuer targets.
- Preserve missing, unknown or malformed knowledge dates as not recorded in EN/ZH; source publication and Planned lifecycle remain independent. Valid recorded first-seen dates retain their existing display.
- Include generated pages, incumbent GMI CI registration, production-render regression tests, dated browser evidence and editable Paper workflow/build views.
- Bring the full index directly to search with one title/date, a 44 px Clear search action, coherent filtered counts, and a mobile Category + Go control that preserves research context and repeat navigation.
- Bring company evidence to search sooner, distinguish matching counts from catalogue coverage, and recover keyboard focus before results disappear.

The canonical design home is [GMI Explorer · Product system](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-1-0). Start index work on [Index · Search and navigation](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-8-0); [Companies · Evidence and recovery](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-9-0) covers the company workflow; the [source receipt page and 15-module Build](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-7-0) carry the current interaction/source contracts. Original product views and historical references remain preserved; the dated ten-board evidence below describes the earlier product set.

## Current source and focused verification — 9 November 2026

Current head: [`49d47033f4d758af2ec7212fccee04d762fec956`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/commit/49d47033f4d758af2ec7212fccee04d762fec956). The PR remains **Draft and unmerged**, with the release/model holds below unchanged.

The latest change brings company evidence directly to its task: a compact Company evidence / 公司证据 header, the existing search, a correctly scoped company count and dated source cards. Active searches report **matching companies**; an unfiltered catalogue retains **companies with evidence on file**. Clear search and history/filter changes move owned focus to search before hiding a card or no-match container. Existing URL, history, locale, return and card owners remain in place.

The company page already had one snapshot. This change removes repeated introduction/breadcrumb/title instructions and the final duplicate qualification, while preserving the 3 November 2026 snapshot, each source's separate publication date, complete card evidence and interpretation guide. Genuine empty-catalogue behavior remains separate from no matching results.

| Evidence | Exact scope |
|---|---|
| Latest company-entry matrix | **29 cases / 29 fresh anonymous contexts**, Chrome157.0.8103.39, zero page errors: 11 header scenarios, six company focus/count paths, four actually without JavaScript, two production-rendered empty-catalogue fixtures, two source-context cases, two real issuer/return journeys and two category-picker regressions |
| Real interaction and layout | Native Clear click/Enter/Space, focus before hide, real back/forward, repeated-write suppression, localized active/blank/whitespace count scope and surviving focus; **44 matched layouts**, with **145.98–215.14 px** less space before search; nine final company captures inspected |
| Production renderer and source | 48 checked inputs and the existing accepted e644fa48… model; all nine parent outputs reproduced exactly; final rendered changes limited to company HTML and paired JS/CSS, with all six other HTML pages byte-identical; all eleven changed files published and read back exactly |
| Earlier category navigation at `9bdc486c` | 24 cases: pending native Category select + explicit Go, retained anchors, typeahead, repeat navigation, empty categories, filtering/locale, stale targets and responsive focus. Desktop and no-JS keep native links |
| Earlier index header at `20179e31` | 23 cases, 66 matched layouts, 145.98–233.89 px less space before search; one title/date, complete returns and the existing Brain reservation. These are retained dated measurements |
| Earlier Clear at `16a87f43` | 36 cases / 42 fresh contexts covering tree/index activation, filtering, locale, focus, URL and native fallback. Earlier evidence remains tied to its recorded source |
| Paper readback | Four company phones distinguish match, catalogue, no-match and genuine-empty fixture; a complete card exposes below-fold source/issuer actions. Build has **15 modules / 48 nodes**. Original index/company views and all 45 prior Build node IDs/styles/parents remain exact outside four intentional source/proof text changes |

Read [DESIGN_RECORD §§11.19–11.30](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/49d47033f4d758af2ec7212fccee04d762fec956/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/DESIGN_RECORD.md), [company-entry validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/49d47033f4d758af2ec7212fccee04d762fec956/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/COMPANY_ENTRY_VALIDATION_20261109.json), [category validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/9bdc486c6b7622d9f306d29e9d12d572ed88415c/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/CATEGORY_PICKER_VALIDATION_20261109.json), [index-header comparison](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/20179e319a3f5219488fda4f1642a49e77ed8b13/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/INDEX_HEADER_VALIDATION_20261109.json) and [Clear validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/16a87f43743fe3a9bae02db7e3d64969871d8cd9/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/SEARCH_CLEAR_VALIDATION_20261109.json). Baseline company proof retains two expected Reset focus failures. An earlier 29-case candidate pass is explicitly superseded by the final filtered-count wording proof.

These are exact-source rendering and anonymous component results. Empty catalogue, Brain launcher and stale clocks are explicit fixtures. No current-head hosted CI, OS-native select popup, spoken assistive-technology, full shared shell/fonts, shared Brain runtime, live-account, public-admission or deployment acceptance is claimed.

## Release blocker — keep draft

**Keep Draft and all no-merge/no-Ready/no-un-draft/no-enqueue/no-relabel holds. No auto-merge or deployment is authorized while these holds remain.**

Original model run `gmi-product-upgrade-20261103-model01` remains **EFFECT_UNKNOWN / ROOT_UNVERIFIED**, with root `gmi-paper-makeover-20261103-sol`, parent `gmi-product-upgrade-20261103-sol`, original controller PID `38742` and lease `868f3981b9bd`.
